groups.label: Processes and mechanisms
groups.description: Behavioural, cognitive and affective processes that sit beside the twelve core mechanisms.

groups.label: Relational and defensive patterns
groups.description: Attachment strategies, interpersonal processes and the defence constructs used in psychodynamic formulation.

groups.label: Biological and physical contributors
groups.description: Medical, neurological, developmental and treatment-related contributors that must be excluded or accounted for before a psychological mechanism is adopted.

groups.label: Social and structural context
groups.description: Circumstances outside the person that shape presentation, access and recovery.

groups.label: Cultural and identity context

concepts.title: Affect intolerance
concepts.summary: Distress about having an emotion, possibly followed by efforts to escape it.

concepts.title: Checking / compulsive response
concepts.summary: Repeated checking or ritualised responses that may relate to doubt or an intrusive concern.

concepts.title: Conditioning / learned associations
concepts.summary: A learned relation between cues, responses and consequences.

concepts.title: Distress-driven impulsivity / negative urgency
concepts.summary: Rapid action during distress with limited opportunity for deliberation.

concepts.title: Guilt
concepts.summary: Concern about an action or responsibility for harm, distinct from but overlapping with global shame.

concepts.title: Hopelessness / future constriction
concepts.summary: Expectation that improvement or workable alternatives are unavailable.

concepts.title: Intolerance of uncertainty
concepts.summary: Difficulty tolerating not knowing what will happen, with associated distress or control efforts.

concepts.title: Negative reinforcement
concepts.summary: An aversive state decreases after a response, potentially making that response more likely.

concepts.title: Safety behaviours
concepts.summary: An action intended to prevent or reduce a feared outcome or distress.

concepts.title: Self-criticism
concepts.summary: Harsh or punitive self-evaluation.

concepts.title: Threat appraisal
concepts.summary: An interpretation that an event, sensation or interaction signals danger.

concepts.title: Trauma-related threat processing
concepts.summary: A possible relationship between trauma exposure, cues, threat processing and current responses.

concepts.title: Acting out
concepts.summary: Expressing conflict through action rather than reflection.

concepts.title: Attachment anxiety / hyperactivation
concepts.summary: Concern about availability or loss of attachment figures, potentially accompanied by intensified proximity seeking.

concepts.title: Denial
concepts.summary: Not acknowledging a distressing aspect of reality or experience.

concepts.title: Displacement
concepts.summary: Redirecting an affect towards a different target.

concepts.title: Family/system accommodation
concepts.summary: Family or support responses that participate in symptoms or repeated avoidance.

concepts.title: Idealisation / devaluation
concepts.summary: Exaggerated positive or negative appraisal of self or others.

concepts.title: Intellectualisation
concepts.summary: Using abstraction to distance from affect.

concepts.title: Isolation of affect
concepts.summary: Representing an event with reduced connection to its affect.

concepts.title: Mentalising / reflective functioning
concepts.summary: Understanding one’s own and others’ behaviour in terms of mental states.

concepts.title: Reaction formation
concepts.summary: Expressing an attitude opposite to a difficult impulse.

concepts.title: Rejection sensitivity
concepts.summary: Recurrent expectation or detection of rejection with a marked response.

concepts.title: Therapeutic rupture and repair
concepts.summary: A difficulty in collaboration, goals, tasks or trust, followed by efforts to understand and address it.

concepts.title: Undoing
concepts.summary: Attempting to symbolically cancel an unacceptable act or feeling.

concepts.title: Cognitive impairment / delirium
concepts.summary: Change or difficulty in attention, memory, orientation, reasoning or other cognitive functions.

concepts.title: Medical, neurological and endocrine contributors
concepts.summary: Relevant physical disease, neurological change, endocrine disturbance or other medical contributors.

concepts.title: Medication and iatrogenic effects
concepts.summary: Symptoms temporally related to medication, adverse effects, interactions, withdrawal or treatment experiences.

concepts.title: Neurodevelopmental and executive-function factors
concepts.summary: Lifelong attention, learning, communication, sensory or executive-function differences and their environmental fit.

concepts.title: Pain and physical symptom burden
concepts.summary: Physical symptom burden, its meaning, activity effects and treatment consequences.

concepts.title: Sleep and circadian disruption
concepts.summary: Timing, continuity, quantity and subjective need for sleep, and changes from baseline.

concepts.title: Substance intoxication, withdrawal and reinforcement
concepts.summary: Intoxication, withdrawal, craving, patterns of use and consequences in relation to symptoms.

concepts.title: Caregiving, parenting and role strain
concepts.summary: Responsibilities, relationships, identity and demands connected with care or parenting.

concepts.title: Housing, financial and occupational instability
concepts.summary: Housing, financial, occupational or educational conditions affecting daily life and access to care.

concepts.title: Justice/legal context
concepts.summary: Relevant legal uncertainty, restrictions, justice contact or advocacy needs.

concepts.title: Service fragmentation / access barriers
concepts.summary: Discontinuity, access barriers, inconsistent messages or mismatched care.

concepts.title: Social isolation / loneliness
concepts.summary: Limited contact or connection; loneliness is the subjective experience of insufficient connection.

concepts.title: Dynamic risk state and change from baseline
concepts.summary: Current safety-relevant change compared with the person’s own baseline.
searchTerms: Dynamic risk state and change from baseline

concepts.title: Foreseeable scenarios, means/opportunity and mitigations
concepts.summary: Plausible future circumstances, relevant access or opportunity, and preventive actions.

concepts.title: Protective factors and reliability
concepts.summary: Whether a proposed support or resource is actually available and usable in the relevant scenario.

concepts.title: Strengths, agency, values and recovery goals
concepts.summary: Capabilities, preferences, values, relationships and roles the person wants to use or preserve.
searchTerms: Strengths, agency, values and recovery goals
